This step deletes one or more payment sessions.

Note: This step should not be used alone as it doesn't consider a revert
Use [deletePaymentSessionsWorkflow](/references/core_flows/Payment_Collection/Workflows_Payment_Collection/functions/core_flows.Payment_Collection.Workflows_Payment_Collection.deletePaymentSessionsWorkflow) instead, which uses this step.
